title: FairShare - Splitwise Clone
description: A fully client-side expense tracking app for groups using React and localStorage, with realtime UI sync via React Query.

details.overview: FairShare demonstrates an offline-first approach with optimistic updates and simple reconciliation logic for shared expenses.
details.challenges: Implementing offline-first architecture with localStorage while maintaining data consistency
details.learnings: Deep understanding of state management and optimistic updates in React applications

title: Mental Health Chatbot
description: An empathetic AI assistant for mental health support using local PDF knowledge, Groq API, and offline LLM fallbacks.

details.overview: This project explores safe fallback strategies and how to combine local documents with remote LLMs to create a privacy-first assistant.
details.challenges: Balancing response quality with privacy concerns and implementing reliable fallback mechanisms
details.learnings: LLM integration patterns and privacy-preserving AI application design

title: Virtual Traffic Police
description: Real-time vehicle detection using YOLOv10, OpenCV streaming, and FFmpeg integration for edge deployment.

details.overview: This project covers model selection, video piping, and performance tradeoffs when deploying detection on resource-constrained hardware.
details.challenges: Optimizing YOLOv10 for real-time performance on edge devices
details.learnings: Computer vision optimization and edge deployment strategies

title: E-commerce Platform
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, product filtering, cart functionality, and admin dashboard.

details.overview: Complete e-commerce solution with modern tech stack and scalable architecture.
details.challenges: Building a scalable architecture that handles concurrent users and transactions
details.learnings: Full-stack development, database design, and payment gateway integration

title: Weather Dashboard
description: A weather application that provides current weather data and forecasts for any location. Built with React and integrated with the OpenWeatherMap API.

details.overview: Interactive weather dashboard with real-time data and beautiful visualizations.
details.challenges: Handling API rate limits and caching strategies
details.learnings: API integration and data visualization techniques

title: AI Meeting Scheduler Agent
description: An Agentic AI-powered meeting scheduler built using LangFlow + LLM Agents + Google Calendar API.

details.overview: Automates end-to-end meeting scheduling with intelligent validation, slot detection, and conversational interaction.
details.challenges: Integrating Google Calendar API with LangFlow and ensuring robust time conflict validation
details.learnings: Building agentic AI workflows and integrating external APIs for real-world automation

title: AlgoVault
description: AlgoVault is a modern, premium web platform designed to be your personal Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) workspace.

details.overview: AlgoVault is a modern, premium web platform designed to be your personal Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) workspace. It provides a distraction-free, LeetCode-inspired environment to organize your coding problems, write algorithmic strategies, and execute code directly in your browser.
features: Analytics Dashboard with SVG donut charts
Workspace Control Bar with real-time search
Full-Featured Code Workspace with Monaco Editor
details.challenges: Integrating live code execution securely and managing complex workspace state
details.learnings: Building robust web platforms with Next.js 16 and Supabase OTP Authentication
